mechanism: Amikacin causes nephrotoxicity leading to acute kidney injury, which impairs dapagliflozin efficacy and increases risk of euglycemic diabetic ketoacidosis (euDKA); dapagliflozin-associated renal effects may be compounded by aminoglycoside-induced tubular damage.
action: Monitor renal function closely with baseline and regular serum creatinine/eGFR assessment; consider alternative antibiotics with lower nephrotoxic potential; educate patient on euDKA symptoms; assess volume status and ensure adequate hydration.
